title: Intrinsic Evaluation of RAG Systems for Deep-Logic Questions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and logical evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using metrics like BERTSim and the proposed Overall Performance Index (OPI). It analyzes various logical reasoning categories such as causal, deductive, and temporal logic, but does not investigate or benchmark religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical considerations.
